design.killed_bounds: N0 - N(t) <= K <= N0 x control fold - N(t)
design.background_bounds: arm's own 0-h value (0 where unmeasured) <= B <= least free LPS of any arm of the same experiment at that time
design.lower_bound: per-killed release of ceftazidime at its smallest over the bounds, of imipenem at its largest
design.central: K at its lower bound and B at its minimum, for both agents

unidentified: absolute release per killed cell: the assay's ng scale and the upper bound on killed biomass
the split between lysis-coupled and kill-independent (filament) release
background shedding as a function of growth (controls show it is large and phase-dependent)
transfer from broth free LPS to in vivo plasma exposure, which is where the assumed range comes from
